plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels calls the USS Omaha case, involving a Navy ship off San Diego in July 2019, a very controversial and interesting one, centred on a video of a round object near the ship. A retired Navy admiral, Tim Gallaudet, tells it second-hand from an officer named Alexander Wiggins, who Gallaudet says was on the Omaha's bridge, and he puts the weight on the moment the spherical object goes into the water. If true, it would mean an object able to move from the air into the sea.
